text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Whoa... Holy cow! What is this feeling?!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(That should've been my top speed
already, but I
wanna to push myself to
go even faster!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Spectacular. That performance was a
true
paradigm of your own
self—powerful and
straightforward.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I, too, must carry such scorching passion!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But you know what?! I feel like I'm on
fire, and the
flames just won't go out! I'm
burning hot!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry back to campus so I can get
back to
training! The sooner the better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory seems even more
energized
than before the race. I guess
we shouldn't let this
incredible
motivation go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay! Thanks so much!
choice_data_list: 戻ったら反省会兼トレーニングだな！
戻ったら反省会兼トレーニングだね！
choice_data_list_en: Once we get back, it's debrief and training!
Once we get back, it's debrief and training time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Time to sprint my way to
campus!
Ready or not, here I—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Nearly forgot about that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's debut race ends with
her
burning up with excitement and
impatience for
the next race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after her debut race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory and I hold a meeting to
discuss
her plans moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What do you think I should do with the
rest of my
junior year, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory has a lot of natural
talent, but
we still don't know what
races will help her shine
the brightest.
choice_data_list: まずは、焦らずに経験を積んでいこう
choice_data_list_en: First, let's take our time and build up experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why we should take things slow
and use her
junior year to refine her
speed and determine the
best races for
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In other words...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My training arc?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh man, I love the sound of that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's get things started right away! What
should I
do first? Should I start running?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ack! You stopped me just in time. I was
about to
speed my way over to the track
again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But okay! I understand what I gotta do!
My very
own training arc... I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Bamboo Memory's exciting
junior year
training arc begins!
